summary: Unnamed skier fell approximately 1,000 feet down the San Joaquin Couloir in upper Bear Creek, suffering extensive head injuries; found by another skier, who called 911 at about 1:35 p.m.; San Miguel County SAR with Telluride Ski Patrol and Helitrax lowered him about 200 feet to a landing zone, flew him by Helitrax to Telluride Regional Airport, then by CareFlight to St. Mary's Hospital in Grand Junction; recovering from a concussion at press time.
location: San Joaquin Couloir, upper Bear Creek, Telluride
responding_agency: San Miguel County Search and Rescue
